# Descriptions
@@ 1
The caster senses the presence of any Holy or Unholy objects in the area.
Caster may concentrate on a different area each round.
@@ 2
Target gains 1 corruption point.
@@ 3
Target Channeling spell user loses some of his faith in his church, religion,
deity, etc. For the duration of this spell, all of target’s spells will
require a spell casting static maneuver with a special penalty of -20 (-10 if
target is a Hybrid spell user, -5 if target is an Arcane spell user).
@@ 4
Target becomes guilty over some action in his past. The GM should choose some
significant event in the target’s past. He will not perform similar actions
again and must take steps to alleviate the guilt.
@@ 5
The target may not send or receive spells or power points for the duration. In
addition, target may not ''regain'' spent PPs for the duration.
@@ 6
Target will trust no one absolutely. When in a life threatening/dangerous
situation, there is a 50% chance (modified by Self Discipline bonus x 3) that
he will not put his safety in the hands of others.
@@ 7
Target gains 3 corruption points.
@@ 8
As Faith Destruction I, except the penalty is -30 (-15 for hybrids; and -10
for Arcane users).
@@ 9
The target believes he has fallen into disfavor with his lord, church,
religion, deity, etc. The target will take irrational actions to regain favor.
@@ 10
Target loses all faith in other beings. He believes that no one can or should
help him in any way and that he should face all his problems alone. He refuses
to accept help from anyone.
@@ 11
Target loses all Channeling power points. He cannot cast any Channeling spells
(even through bonus items). A hybrid spell user of Channeling would only lose
half of his PPs. Certain Channelers with high Divine Status may gain a bonus
to their RRs versus this spell.
@@ 12
As Faith Destruction I, except the penalty is -50 (-25 for hybrids; and -15
for Arcane users).
@@ 13
Target may not call upon his deity for help for the duration.
@@ 14
Target gains 5 corruption points.
@@ 15
One of the Black Channell spells may be used (see Section 15.23 in Spell Luw).
@@ 16
As Block Channel, except for the duration.
@@ 17
Target gains 7 corruption points.
@@ 18
As Faith Destruction I, except the penalty is -80 (-40 for hybrids; and -20
for Arcane users).
@@ 19
As Paranoia, except target will never put his safety in the hands of others
and will believe that everyone is out to get him.
@@ 20
Target gains 10 corruption points.
@@ 25
One of the Black Channel II spells may be used (see Section 15.23 in Spell
Law).
@@ 30
Target gains 15 corruption points.
@@ 50
One of the Black Chunnel III spells may be used (see Section 15.23 in Spell
Law).
